summary: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K on August 26, 2026, reporting entry into Amendment No. 1 to the Insider Letter with K2 Capital Sponsor LLC and insiders. The amendment alters lock-up provisions for founders shares and private placement units following a future initial business combination, shortening the private placement lock-up from 180 to 30 days and easing founders share transferability conditions. This is a routine SPAC governance filing, not an event triggering special-situations categorization. No deal terms, prices, or premiums are stated. Watch for subsequent business combination announcements.
